0.headline: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO likely to open next week, issue size expected around $1 billion
0.heading: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO likely to open next week, issue size expected around $1 billion
0.intro: Mahanadi Coalfields is likely to launch its maiden IPO next week, with Coal India planning to sell up to 66.18 crore shares, or 10% of its stake, through an offer for sale estimated at Rs 9,500 crore.
0.body:
Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL), a wholly owned subsidiary of Coal India Limited, is likely to launch its maiden public offering next week, according to sources.

The issue size is expected to be around $1 billion, or approximately Rs 9,500 crore, people with knowledge of the matter said.

The proposed public issue will comprise an offer for sale (OFS) of up to 66.18 crore equity shares by Coal India, according to the company's draft red herring prospectus (DRHP).

Coal India plans to divest up to 10% of its stake in Mahanadi Coalfields through the proposed IPO. The issue will be conducted through the book-building route, with the company's equity shares proposed to be listed on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and BSE.

SEBI issued its final observations on the draft offer document on November 4, clearing the way for the company to proceed with preparations for the public issue.

Since the issue comprises only an OFS, Mahanadi Coalfields will not receive any proceeds from the IPO. The entire amount raised through the share sale will go to Coal India.

Read More: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: Coal India to divest up to 10% stake; here's everything you should know

The company has proposed to reserve not more than 50% of the net offer for qualified institutional buyers (QIBs), while not less than 15% will be allocated to non-institutional investors (NIIs). Retail individual investors will be eligible for at least 35% of the net offer.

1.headline: Sembcorp Green Infra, Razorpay, MakeMyTrip get SEBI nod for IPOs
1.heading: Sembcorp Green Infra, Razorpay, MakeMyTrip get SEBI nod for IPOs
1.intro: Razorpay Software and MakeMyTrip India approached the capital markets regulator by filing their draft offer documents through the confidential pre-filing route in June and July, respectively, while Sembcorp Green Infra filed its DRHP with SEBI in August.
1.body:
Razorpay Software, MakeMyTrip India and Sembcorp Green Infra have received approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to proceed with their proposed initial public offerings (IPOs).

Razorpay Software and MakeMyTrip India approached the capital markets regulator by filing their draft offer documents through the confidential pre-filing route in June and July this year, respectively, while Sembcorp Green Infra filed its draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) with SEBI in August.

Under SEBI's confidential pre-filing route, companies can submit draft offer documents without publicly disclosing sensitive business and financial information.

SEBI issued its observations on Razorpay Software's confidential draft offer documents on November 3, MakeMyTrip India's on November 6, and Sembcorp Green Infra's IPO papers on November 13, according to the processing status of draft offer documents for the week published on November 13.

The issuance of observations allows companies to proceed with their IPO plans. Companies opting for the confidential filing route have 18 months to launch their IPOs after receiving SEBI's observations, compared with 12 months for those following the regular filing route.

Moneycontrol was the first to report that Y Combinator- and Peak XV-backed fintech unicorn Razorpay Software is looking to go public as early as the first quarter of calendar year 2027, at a valuation of $5 billion. The proposed public issue is expected to raise $500–600 million, although the final issue size could change depending on market conditions and investor demand.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

Founded in 2014 by IIT Roorkee alumni Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar, Razorpay is among India's largest fintech companies, offering payment processing and banking solutions to businesses. It competes with Prosus-backed PayU, Cashfree Payments, Pine Labs, PhonePe and Paytm. Its investors include GIC, Peak XV Partners and Tiger Global.

Meanwhile, the proposed IPO of Nasdaq-listed travel booking platform MakeMyTrip's Indian subsidiary is expected to comprise an offer for sale (OFS) of equity shares by its parent, MakeMyTrip, and its wholly owned subsidiary, ibibo Group Holdings (Singapore) Pte Ltd, the Gurugram-headquartered company said in a regulatory filing with Nasdaq.

Following the completion of the proposed IPO, MMT India will continue to remain a subsidiary of MakeMyTrip, with its financial results continuing to be consolidated with those of the parent company, it had said.

Temasek Holdings-backed Sembcorp Green Infra, a Haryana-based renewable independent power producer, is looking to raise Rs 3,750 crore through its IPO. The proposed issue comprises an entirely fresh issue of shares, including a pre-IPO placement of Rs 750 crore.

Of the net proceeds from the issue, Rs 3,000 crore will be utilised to repay debt, while the remaining amount will be used for general corporate purposes.

2.headline: Crystal Crop Protection IPO GMP at 17% ahead of issue opening on November 18; check issue size, price band and key details here
2.heading: Crystal Crop Protection IPO GMP at 17% ahead of issue opening on November 18; check issue size, price band and key details here
2.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of Crystal Crop Protection is commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of nearly 17 percent ahead of its subscription opening on November 18.
2.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of Crystal Crop Protection is commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of nearly 17 percent ahead of its subscription opening on November 18.

In the grey market, Crystal Crop Protection IPO was trading at a premium of Rs 45 per share as of November 13, according to data from InvestorGain. This translates into a GMP of around 16.54 percent over the upper end of the IPO price band of Rs 272.

Going by the latest grey market premium, the estimated listing price of Crystal Crop Protection shares stands at around Rs 317 apiece, marking a potential gain of approximately 16.5 percent over the issue price.

Read Also: Crystal Crop Protection fixes price band at Rs 259-272 per share for Rs 456-crore IPO, issue opens November 18

However, the grey market premium is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment and does not guarantee listing gains. It can fluctuate depending on market conditions and should not be considered a prediction of the actual listing price.

Crystal Crop Protection has fixed the price band for its upcoming IPO at Rs 259-272 per equity share. At the upper end of the price band, the agrochemicals company is seeking a valuation of around Rs 4,438 crore.

The company aims to raise approximately Rs 455.7 crore through the public issue, which will open for subscription on November 18 and close on November 20. The bidding for anchor investors will take place on November 17.

The IPO comprises a fresh issue of equity shares worth up to Rs 354.77 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 37.03 lakh equity shares aggregating to around Rs 100.71 crore.

While the proceeds from the fresh issue will go to the company, the OFS component will allow existing shareholders to sell their stakes.

The three-day public issue will open on November 18 and close on November 20. The basis of allotment is expected to be finalised on November 23, while the initiation of refunds and credit of shares to demat accounts are scheduled for November 25.

The shares are tentatively scheduled to list on the BSE and NSE on November 26.

About Crystal Crop Protection

Established in 1994, Crystal Crop Protection is a crop solutions company headquartered in New Delhi. Its business portfolio includes agrochemicals, seeds and other agricultural solutions.

The company manufactures and markets crop protection products, including herbicides, fungicides and insecticides, along with natural crop solutions and seeds for field crops, vegetables and flowers.
